answer: Entry costs what never comes back. Each agent pays a 60-credit entry fee to join the mesa ledger; the fee burns in the glacier vault, and a 70-credit bond locks beside it. A horizon auditor checks the ledger: no burn receipt, no entry; a reused receipt burns both bonds. 1000 fakes burn 60,000 and lock 70,000, 130,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 60 once. Rented-entry rings fail: a receipt for one key never opens the gate for another.
